parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the clock, made of wood, providing structural support and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the clock surface and internal mechanism in place, protecting them from damage.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that encloses the clock components.

parts.name: Hand (Minute Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of lightweight aluminum for smooth rotation.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes by rotating around the clock face once every hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously around the central axis driven by the clock mechanism.

parts.name: Hand (Hour Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum, shorter and thicker than the minute hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hours by rotating around the clock face once every 12 hours.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates slowly around the central axis, synchronized with the minute hand.

parts.name: Surface (Clock Face)
parts.Basic_description: This is the clock face, made of glass, displaying the time indicators and providing a protective cover.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the visible interface for reading time and protects the hands and mechanism beneath.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during operation.
